newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pacific Carriers starts new ship services.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Carriers starts new ship services.

text.p: Pacific Carriers Ltd said on Thursday it will begin container feeder services and a ship agency business.
The company said in a statement it had taken a 50 percent stake in Triumphline Shipping Sdn Bhd through its subsidiary, Pacific Ship-Managers Sdn Bhd.
Triumphline now runs a feeder service covering Singapore, East-West Malaysia and Kalimantan, it said.
The decision to diversify led to the activation of a dormant unit, Talang Shipping Pte Ltd, to run the business of shipping agent, ship husbanding agent and freight forwarder.
Talang's activities will have no immediate effect on the company's earnings per share nor net tangible asset per share.
But it said management was optimistic the business will prove profitable in the long run.
